name: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A modern responsive portfolio website showcasing my skills, projects, internship experience, certifications, and professional achievements. Features include project filtering, GitHub integration, resume download, dark mode, and interactive UI components.
problemSolved: Provides a centralized platform for recruiters and employers to explore my technical skills, projects, certifications, internship experience, and contact information in a professional and accessible format.

name: Contact Exporter
description: A browser-based contact backup application that allows users to export phone contacts to Excel and CSV formats. Features contact search, sorting, duplicate removal, dark mode, and a responsive mobile-friendly interface.
problemSolved: Provides a simple and secure way for users to back up and export phone contacts without installing additional applications.

name: AI Spend Analyzer
description: An AI-powered financial analytics platform that detects duplicate transactions, identifies spending anomalies using machine learning, and provides cost-saving recommendations through interactive dashboards and automated reporting.
problemSolved: Helps organizations identify cost leakage, detect unusual spending patterns, automate financial analysis, and generate actionable insights for better decision-making.

name: Personal Finance Dashboard
description: An interactive finance analytics dashboard that visualizes financial data, tracks key performance metrics, and provides actionable insights through dynamic charts and reports. Built to support data-driven financial decision-making.
problemSolved: Transforms raw financial data into meaningful insights through interactive dashboards, helping users monitor trends, analyze performance, and make informed financial decisions.

name: Neon Kinetic Particles
description: A real-time interactive 3D particle system that uses webcam-based hand tracking to control thousands of particles through natural gestures. Features dynamic shape morphing, particle physics simulation, motion blur effects, and gesture-triggered visual interactions.
problemSolved: Demonstrates intuitive human-computer interaction by enabling gesture-based control of a real-time 3D particle environment using computer vision and browser-based graphics rendering.
